tools.name: GARbro
tools.integration: Call CLI/console build or reuse format knowledge for archive extraction; keep script text extraction in project adapters.
tools.notes: Very broad VN archive coverage, but last GitHub release is old. Best used as an external optional tool.

tools.name: Kuriimu2
tools.integration: Use as a reference and optional external adapter for formats with existing plugins.
tools.notes: Good project manager/toolkit model for many game-specific formats.

tools.name: UnityPy
tools.integration: Import as optional dependency for TextAsset, MonoBehaviour typetree, asset bundle text extraction and reinsertion.
tools.notes: Python library, fits this codebase well.

tools.name: AssetRipper
tools.integration: Use externally for analysis/recovery, avoid bundling unless GPL obligations are acceptable.
tools.notes: Excellent for full Unity project reconstruction, less ideal for lightweight text-only patching.

tools.name: RPGMaker Trans
tools.integration: Use as external adapter for older RPG Maker versions; do not copy GPL code into permissive core.
tools.notes: Patch-file workflow is useful for version-tolerant translations.

tools.name: RPGMTranslate
tools.integration: Use as an optional external workflow, especially for older RPG Maker assets.
tools.notes: Open-source RPG Maker translation tool with write-back semantics.

tools.name: rpatool
tools.integration: Use as optional library/subprocess for .rpa extraction and repacking.
tools.notes: Can create, modify, list, extract Ren'Py RPA/RPI archives.

tools.name: unrpyc
tools.integration: Call externally when .rpy source is absent; keep license boundary clear.

tools.name: wolftrans
tools.integration: Use as reference or subprocess for Wolf RPG text extraction and patching.

tools.name: KirikiriTools
tools.integration: Use externally for XP3 pack/unpack and patch overlays.
tools.notes: Helpful for avoiding encrypted archive rebuild problems.

tools.name: VNTranslationTools
tools.integration: Use as design reference; repository is archived.
tools.notes: Explicitly targets extracting original text and patching translated text into VN formats.
